from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,itertools,json,resource,time
resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(55,55));resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(1536*1024**2,)*2)
start=time.monotonic()
import sympy as s
u,v,z,w,a,lam,t=s.symbols('u v z w a lam t');xx=(u,v,z,w)
pairs=list(itertools.combinations(range(4),2));triples=list(itertools.combinations(range(4),3))
g=s.symbols('g:6')
def matrix(entries):
 M=s.zeros(4)
 for(i,j),f in zip(pairs,entries):M[i,j]=f;M[j,i]=-f
 return M
def jac(P):
 return[s.expand(sum(P[i,l]*s.diff(P[j,k],xx[l])+P[j,l]*s.diff(P[k,i],xx[l])+P[k,l]*s.diff(P[i,j],xx[l])for l in range(4)))for i,j,k in triples]
def pf(P):return s.expand(P[0,1]*P[2,3]-P[0,2]*P[1,3]+P[0,3]*P[1,2])
R=matrix([g0*xx[i]*xx[j]for g0,(i,j)in zip(g,pairs)])
cases={'lagrangian':(lam,[-2*u*u+(2*lam-2)*w,-lam*u,0,(4-4*lam)*u*z-(2-lam)*v,4*lam*u*w,2*w+(2-2*lam)*u*u]),
       'symplectic':(a,[3*a*v,3*(1-a)*z,3*(w+u*u),w+u*u,6*a*u*v,6*(1-a)*u*z])}
output={}
for name,(param,entries)in cases.items():
 P=matrix(entries);assert jac(P)==[0]*4
 equations=[]
 for f in jac(P+t*R):
  polar=s.expand(f).coeff(t,1)
  equations.extend(s.Poly(polar,*xx).coeffs())
 A=s.linear_eq_to_matrix(equations,g)[0]
 basis=A.nullspace()
 nspars=s.symbols(f'b0:{len(basis)}')
 generic=sum([q*b for q,b in zip(nspars,basis)],s.zeros(6,1))
 RG=R.subs(dict(zip(g,generic)))
 determinant=s.factor(pf(RG))
 record={'parameter':str(param),'P_six':list(map(str,entries)),'Pfaffian_P':str(s.factor(pf(P))),
         'linear_log_compatibility_shape':list(A.shape),'log_compatibility_rank':A.rank(),
         'log_compatibility_nullspace':[list(map(str,b))for b in basis],
         'general_log_coefficients':list(map(str,generic)),'Pfaffian_log':str(determinant)}
 if determinant!=0:
  # One predetermined combination: all nullspace coefficients equal to one.
  value=generic.subs(dict.fromkeys(nspars,s.S.One));RR=R.subs(dict(zip(g,value)))
  if pf(RR)!=0:
   assert jac(P+t*RR)==[0]*4
   record.update(universal_pencil_verified=True,R_six=[str(RR[i,j])for i,j in pairs],
       Pfaffian_R=str(s.factor(pf(RR))),Pfaffian_pencil=str(s.factor(pf(P+t*RR))))
  else:record['universal_pencil_verified']=False
 else:record['universal_pencil_verified']=False
 output[name]=record
result={'task_id':'E_quadric3','cases':output,'seconds':time.monotonic()-start,
 'source':Path(__file__).read_text(),'source_sha256':hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
 'scope':'Exact rational-function-field logcanonical compatibility for two complete primitive normal-form families; generic nonzero Pfaffian plus closedness can cover that family. No nonprimitive source exhaustion claimed.'}
path=Path('/workspace/poisson-p4/work/rank3-primitive-universal-log-pencil-result.json')
path.write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in result.items()if k!='source'},indent=2))
